verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no vendor documentation of transcription models, accuracy figures, benchmarks, or known limits. The first-party material only says that files are 'automatically transcribed' and that Otter offers 'live transcription in multiple languages, and speaker recognition' and team vocabulary. Community remarks on accuracy are user anecdotes, not vendor transparency, so they cannot credit this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, the vendor documents how transcription actually works and its quality (models, accuracy claims, known limits) rather than just saying "AI-powered"
